name: WSO2 API Manager — Enterprise API Gateway with YugabyteDB
postStartCommand: bash .devcontainer/scripts/start-wso2.sh && echo '▶  Open terminals:  wso2-demo  →  wso2-ws'

tasks.label: wso2-demo
tasks.detail: WSO2 APIM with YugabyteDB (wso2_amdb + wso2_shareddb) — YB JDBC driver demo (init-wso2/prompt.sh)
tasks.command: cd init-wso2 && echo '🔷 wso2-demo  —  WSO2 API Manager + YugabyteDB' && echo '   Run when ready: bash prompt.sh' && exec bash

tasks.label: wso2-ws
tasks.detail: Workshop shell for WSO2 API Manager + YugabyteDB manual exercises (init-wso2/)
tasks.command: bash .devcontainer/scripts/wait-for-svc.sh 'https://localhost:9443/' 'WSO2 API Manager :9443' && cd init-wso2 && echo '🔷 wso2-ws  —  Workshop shell' && echo '   Run manual curl / ysqlsh commands here' && exec bash
